plate_findings.evidence: Caption: 'ingrown toenails on both sides digging into the flesh'
Visual: exuberant granulation tissue at the lateral nail fold
Caption: 'severe inflammation and pain'; visual: erythematous, swollen lateral nail fold

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is a preoperative clinical photograph of the left great toe of a 15-year-old male with bilateral ingrown toenails. The caption explicitly describes ingrown toenails digging into the flesh with severe inflammation, and the image shows lateral nail fold erythema, swelling, and hypergranulation tissue consistent with the configured disease. Purple surgical markings are present as annotations. B: Panel B is a preoperative clinical photograph of the right great toe of the same 15-year-old patient with bilateral ingrown toenails. The caption describes ingrown toenails digging into the flesh with severe inflammation, and the image shows a hypertrophic, inflamed lateral nail fold with exuberant granulation tissue, consistent with the configured disease.

in_text_mentions: A 15-year-old male visited our clinic complaining of discomfort due to an ingrown toenail on both great toes ( Fig. 1 .). He complained of pain and inflammation during walking for 4 years and worsening symptoms while playing sports like soccer. He had been previously diagnosed with ingrown toenails at a local hospital, but after six surgeries and various conservative treatments over a 4-year period, the condition recurred several times, and symptoms did not improve.
